cohort: The study population consisted of 162 singleton neonates delivered between January 2020 and May 2023 from pregnancies complicated by suspected preeclampsia, where maternal sFlt-1/PlGF ratio was measured within 4 weeks before delivery.
finding: An elevated maternal sFlt-1/PlGF ratio within 4 weeks of delivery is significantly associated with adverse neonatal outcomes including small-for-gestation, gastrointestinal complications, and prolonged hospitalisation.
followup_time: Observations included neonatal outcomes and hospitalisation duration, implying follow-up until discharge or within the first 30 days of life.
